items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: I wasn't exposed to any big name like John Philip Sousa or Prior or any of the military.

ctx.x: there other, I'm sure, military orchestras? Were they big favorites on the reservation?

Well, during those early years, I wasn't exposed to any big name like John Philip Sousa or Prior or any of the military. You see I was, I was pretty well on the reservation, and you don't get out to hear -- listen to any, any of that, but whatever is exposed to us -- just, just that -- St. John's Mission Band and a once in a while you hear somebody have a record of something -- of one of the tunes or whatever orchestras or bands there were. I can't remember to this time. But most of it was the military band at…
Did you start studying any of the instruments like the trumpet or the cornet or French horn before you left Arizona?
